entities.summary: Michio Yamauchi was a painters & sculptors in Aichi Prefecture (b. 1950-10-23, Aichi Prefecture) who made significant contributions during the Contemporary era. Their work intersected with causality and historical consequence. Produced visual artworks of cultural importance.
